1

How AI was born

The idea is over 70 years old. It just needed time.

1950

“Can machines think?”

Alan Turing asks the question.

1956

The name “Artificial Intelligence”

Coined at Dartmouth College.

2012

Deep learning takes off

GPUs make neural networks work.

2017

The Transformer

The design behind every LLM.

2022

ChatGPT and the LLM era

AI reaches everyone.

3

Technology before & after AI

You already use AI every day — often without noticing.

🔍Google Search

BeforeA long list of links that match your keywords — you read and find the answer yourselfAfterAI Overview — understands your question and answers it on top

🗺️Maps & navigation

BeforeShortest route by distanceAfterPredicts traffic and arrival time

📷Phone camera

BeforeDark, blurry photos at nightAfterNight mode, portrait blur

🔓Phone unlock

BeforePIN or patternAfterFace unlock

🎬YouTube & Netflix

BeforeSame list for everyoneAfterPicks what you will like

📧Email

BeforeInbox full of spamAfterSpam filtered automatically

🌐Translation

BeforeWord-by-word, often wrongAfterNatural full sentences, even by voice

🗣️Voice assistants

BeforeType and tap everythingAfter“Set an alarm for 6 a.m.”

💳Banking & UPI

BeforeFraud found days laterAfterSuspicious payment blocked instantly
4

Data: the most important thing in AI

No data, no AI.
Good data beats a clever algorithm. Bad data in → bad AI out.

3 basic types of data — each has its own AI

Know your data, and you know which AI to use.

Data
🔢

Numerical

Temperature, voltage, sales

Use

Classical Machine Learning

RegressionClassification

Predict a number or a category

🖼️

Image & video

Photos, CCTV, X-rays

Use

Deep Learning

CNN

See and detect objects

📝

Text

Emails, manuals, chats

Use

NLP + Deep Learning

TransformerLLM

Read, understand and write

🔗 Mix them= Multi-modal AI

Numbers + ImageSensor readings + camera
Image + TextAsk ChatGPT about a photo

Training & prediction

AI was born from one idea: teach a machine the way we teach a child.

👶

How we learned

“This is a cat.”

Shown again and again.

→ Now you spot any cat.

=
🤖

How a machine learns

Photo + label: “cat”

Shown thousands of times.

→ Now it spots any cat.

6

AI vs non-AI

Most machines around you are not AI. They follow fixed rules a person wrote.

Non-AI systems

Same input → always the same output. They never learn.

🚦Traffic signalGreen every 60 seconds
🧮CalculatorFixed maths formulas
🏧ATMPIN matches → give cash
❄️AC thermostatAbove 24 °C → cool
🔌Circuit breakerAbove 100 A → trip
🧺Washing machineFixed wash program
🛗LiftGo to the floor pressed
🧾Electricity billUnits × tariff

AI systems

They learned from data — and keep getting better.

🗺️Google MapsPredicts traffic jams
🔓Face unlockRecognises your face
🎬YouTubeLearns what you like
📧Spam filterSpots junk emails
🗣️Voice assistantUnderstands your speech
💳Fraud alertSpots unusual payments
🚗Self-driving carSees the road
💬ChatGPTAnswers in your words

If a formula works, don’t use AI.

8

Words you’ll hear every day

Data
Examples the AI learns from
Label
The correct answer on each example
Algorithm
The learning method
Model
What the AI becomes after learning
Training
Learning from data
Prediction
Answering for new data (also called inference)
Accuracy
How often the answer is right
GPU
The chip that makes AI fast
